tierName: SEQUENCE A: Hotel directors and local owner directors
targetPersonas: Hotel directors and local owner directors

emails.subject: Tableware for {{company}}
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},
I’m reaching out to ask whether you are planning to replenish or update the tableware for your hotel restaurant, breakfast service or other dining areas in the coming months.

At DukeGroup, we specialise in professional tableware for hotels. We represent brands such as FIGGJO and SERAX and help select porcelain, glassware, cutlery and other items to suit each hotel’s needs and concept.

Would you be open to a brief conversation about your plans and how we could work together?

Best regards,
{{signature}}

emails.subject: RE: Tableware for {{company}}
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},
I recently wrote to you about tableware for your hotel.

A conversation could also be useful if you are simply planning to replenish existing stock or select new items for a particular part of your offering, such as breakfast, the restaurant or banqueting.

Based on your needs, I could present a focused selection of products from our portfolio.

Are any of these purchases currently on your agenda?

Best regards,
{{signature}}

emails.subject: RE: Tableware for {{company}}
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

I’m getting back in touch to see whether selecting or replenishing tableware is currently relevant for your hotel.

If so, we could arrange a brief conversation. If a colleague manages this area, I would appreciate being pointed in the right direction.

If you are planning purchases for a later date, please let me know when it would be a good time to reconnect.

Best regards,

{{signature}}

emails.body:
Hello {{FirstName}},

We would like to understand how {{CompanyName}} selects tableware and whether any replenishment is planned.

DukeGroup represents FIGGJO, SERAX and other brands for professional use.

Would a brief discussion of your needs be useful?

Is selection managed locally or through group procurement?

Best regards,
Intelsol for DukeGroup

emails.subject: RE: Equipment selection for {{CompanyName}} - purchasing process
emails.body:
Hello {{FirstName}},

Following up on equipment and tableware for {{CompanyName}}.

Most F&B teams and procurement managers we work with focus on:
- Professional quality and durability
- Design fit with restaurant concept
- Reliable suppliers with good service
- Clear process for approval and ordering

DukeGroup works directly with hotels across Slovenia on supplier relationships and equipment selection.

Would it be helpful to discuss your current process and needs? We can also connect with your director if needed.

Best regards,
Intelsol for DukeGroup

emails.subject: Last message - DukeGroup tableware and equipment for {{CompanyName}}
emails.body:
Hello {{FirstName}},

Last message: if you're planning any tableware or restaurant equipment refresh, we'd welcome a discussion about your needs and DukeGroup's options.

Best regards,
Intelsol for DukeGroup
